title: Why it sucks being a Chelsea fan

scenes.text: Why it sucks being a... Chelsea fan!
It starts when you're seven. You get your first shirt, with your favourite player on the back. Next season, he's sold. So you buy a new shirt. He's sold too.
Age nine. You finally learn the manager's name. By Christmas, there's a new one. Your teacher asks: "Who's your favourite manager?" You say: "This week's?"
Age twelve. The club signs so many players... the team photo needs a drone.
Age fourteen. The club spends over a billion on new players. Your dad says: "We'll win everything." You finish twelfth. At least the shirts are nice.
Age sixteen. One night in Munich. Champions League final. Penalties. Against Bayern. In their own stadium. And you win! Terrible. Now you expect it every year.
Age seventeen. You buy the shirt of the new signing. His contract? Eight years. By January... he's on loan. Don't worry. It's a collector's item now.
That's the thing about being a Chelsea fan. The manager changes. The players change. Even the owner changes.
Tag a Chelsea fan who's still recovering. And which club is next? Drop it in the comments!
